Meet up with [[Oroku (Ministry of Purity)|Oroku]] in the Undercity and investigate the rise in [[Kappa]] problems.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Meet Ministry Agent Oroku in [[The Undercity (Winds_of_Change)|the Undercity]].
* Escort Oroku to the corrupted locations so that he can purify them. [0...3] of 3 purified. Oroku must survive.
* Find the source of the corruption.
* Defeat [[Kai Shi Jo]] and his corrupted kappa.
* See [[Lei Jeng]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*2,000 [[Experience]]
*1,500 [[Gold]]
*[[Imperial Commendation]]

===Environmental changes===
* [[Baubao Wavewrath]] does not [[spawn]] in the Undercity during this quest.

== Walkthrough ==
Enter [[the Undercity]] from the [[Wajjun Bazaar]], via the [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter outpost]]. Since Oroku must survive stay near him at the areas of corruption and let the [[Kappa]] come to you. At each site, the Kappa will attack in 4 waves from each entry point in groups of 3 or 4. Since the Kappa are large groups of [[spellcaster]]s, [[area of effect]] skills and caster [[shutdown]] will be very helpful. Oroku will stay with the party between the sites, so the only danger during movement is the [[Am Fah]]. Take care with these mobs, as it is easy to over-aggro and fail the quest. It is safest, though time consuming, to clear out the path before taking Oroku (either by not entering from south Wajjun Bazaar, or by running past before he finishes the dialogue.)

Once you have cleansed all 3 areas of corruption, Oroku will revive after dying from that point on.

If you have [[Cleansing the Undercity]] active, you can bring along [[Initiate Zei Ri]] as an extra ally to help make this quest easier. Just make sure to complete Oroku's quest first before killing the Afflicted mobs.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lei Jeng
:''"First [[Missing Fire Drake|drakes]] and now kappa! I've got a new report of some violent kappa appearing in the sewers of the Undercity. I'm not sure exactly what is causing it, but they have been attacking some of the citizens that live down there. The Ministry of Purity has volunteered to lend us one of their elites for this job, so you should go and meet Oroku in the Undercity before you start. I would come with you on this job {{sic|Missing a comma}} but there is still a mountain of paperwork to deal with regarding the drakes. Give Oroku my regards."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Lei Jeng
:''"Another Am Fah plot, eh? We had suspected they might have been involved but had no proof. It's a good thing you dealt with it though; having a swarm of corrupted kappa reaching the city proper would have been a disaster. Oroku has already gone back to give his report to the Ministry, so all that's left is your reward."''

== Trivia ==
* This quest has numerous references to the [[w:Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles|Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles]]. The names and colors of the four end bosses reflect each of the main characters; Oroku's name is based on the group's arch-enemy, Oroku Saki; and Hamato is based on the turtles' sensei, Hamato Yoshi.
